verdict.rationale: Render's own materials say it provides ephemeral previews of the whole application architecture for every change, and that every pull request gets its own running copy of the stack, which is the core of this story. The evidence is short marketing and article lines with no detailed preview docs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that each preview exposes a URL and how that URL is surfaced (e.g. on the PR), setup/configuration details for preview environments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get an automatic preview URL for every pull request

citations.quote: Iterate quickly with ephemeral previews of your entire application architecture for every change.
